preconditions.description: Both s and t are strings.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in s are lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: All characters in t are lowercase English letters.
The length of s is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The length of t is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The return value is an integer.
The return value is between 0 and the product of the lengths of s and t inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len({s[:i] + t[:j] for i in range(1, len(s) + 1) for j in range(1, len(t) + 1)})
postconditions.description: The return value is the number of distinct concatenations of non-empty prefixes of s and t.
